request.spec:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I added the settled-total and open-total to each person's row and to the sheet's totals. All 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

The screen already works out the due figures in the browser, so this was a front-end-only change. The server, stored data and audit records are unchanged, since the test expects no new audit lines.

- **Calculation** (`src/main/frontend/src/app/core/figures.ts`):
  - **Settled-total:** adds up the person's SETTLED claims that count, at their frozen figures, corrections included.
  - **Open-total:** adds up their OPEN and PENDING claims that count. Held, deferred and retired-and-excluded claims are left out, the same way the due-total leaves them out.
  - Both reuse the per-claim figure and the "claims that count" list the due-total already uses. Because they split the same claims by status, they add up to the person's due-total before the cap and trim.
  - **Sheet totals:** each is simply everyone's figure added up, with no trimming.
- **Screen** (`src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`):
  - Two new columns, "Settled total" and "Open total", sit after "Due total" on each person's row (`person-settled-total`, `person-open-total`).
  - The sheet's two totals appear next to the existing totals (`rollup-settled-total`, `rollup-open-total`).

When a person's due-total shows n/a (their grade has no rate), their two new figures show 0.00.
